_version: What your game SAYS it is. elo never copies this onto your store row — it serves it beside the version actually published in the depot and flags the gap, because a tag ahead of a build is a signal and a typed field would erase it.
_terms: The version of the community terms you accept: https://elopros.com/terms.html#community. Committing it says you made this game or have the right to list it. The checklist names the current version if this one is out of date.
_multiplayer: How people play together: shard, match, persistent or co-op.

listing.name: Your Game
listing.blurb: The card's sentence: what the game is, in plain words. 400 characters.
listing.about: The long paragraph on the game page.

_listing: Every field a steward may write: name, kind, blurb, about, state, tags, engine, made_with, repo, repo_public, room, play_url, capsule, hero, media, record, coins, collections, economy, receipts. engine is what it is built on. A game listed from its repo gets repo filled in by the door, so leave it out. made_with lists where a model helped (art, code, audio, writing, translation, qa); an empty list means none. Add play_url when the game is up. The house keeps band, hidden, placeholder, lane, note, buddy_url and marquee — a game cannot commit its way onto a shelf.
_sell: To sell copies, add "sell": {"usd_cents": 1000} for $10.00. We list the sale, pay the gas and keep the price on the dollar. Add "wallet": "0x…" when you have one; until then we hold your money for you. The dev console writes both lines for you: https://elopros.com/dev-console.html#sell

updates.title: The headline, 140 characters
updates.body: The update itself, in markdown. This lands in the store's feed and on your title's build record — the row the game page and the hub already render.

_updates: kind is one of update / patch / release / news / event. The `id` is yours and is what makes re-reading this file idempotent: an id that has already posted is skipped, so leaving old entries here is harmless. 20 per manifest.
_next: Fill this in, commit it with a LICENSE, and paste your repo into https://elopros.com/dev-console.html#repo — the checklist says what is missing, and a game listed from its repo needs no signature. Copy elo-sync.yml to .github/workflows/elo.yml and every push updates your page. A game listed with a wallet signs each change instead: python3 sign_manifest.py --game your-slug writes elo.sig.json. Keys starting with _ are your own margin notes and are ignored by elo. Full standard: https://elopros.com/api/library/GAME-REPO.md
